a.xlink:title: Converts readRawVoltage() to degrees relative to _zeroVoltage (360° per 3.3 V).
Relative error between the measured angle and trackedAngle. Unused.
Reads both feedback angles (deg from the Init() zero).
Starts PWM, centres both servos, records the zero reference, and checks they hold position.
Commands both servos and refreshes the feedback data.
Reads every sensor and publishes the results.
Sensor task: reads every sensor, then wakes updateDataTask(). Up to about 500 Hz.

Initializes the IMUs, barometers, GPS, servos and magnetometer.
Inits both servos, then cycles them through 90/−33°, −45/45° and 0/0° forever.
Backup roll damper: one proportional step, then wait for the next frame.
Main roll controller: EKF plus gain-scheduled control law, in its own loop.
Entry point of the CTRLs task, defined in main.cpp.
